meaning: handling people or awkward matters with care, so as not to give offence
sentence: A tactful officer told the cadet his drill was slipping without saying it in front of the squad.

meaning: a story, true or invented, told or written for others
sentence: Our grandfather still tells the tale of the night the river rose above the bridge.

meaning: fond of talking a great deal
sentence: The talkative recruit kept the whole barrack awake with his account of the selection interview.

meaning: to attract somebody towards something, especially something unwise
sentence: The smell from the mess kitchen was enough to tempt him off his diet.

meaning: the quality of holding firmly to a purpose or a grip
sentence: She cleared the obstacle course on her fourth attempt through sheer tenacity.

meaning: a large old building divided into cheap flats, usually in a crowded part of a city
sentence: He grew up in a tenement where four families shared a single water tap.

meaning: lukewarmness, whether of a liquid or of enthusiasm
sentence: The tepidity of the applause told him the speech had not carried.

meaning: a declaration or sign of intended harm or coming danger
sentence: The rising water was a real threat to the villages downstream.

meaning: growing or doing well; flourishing
sentence: A thriving little market has grown up outside the cantonment gate.

meaning: very hot and dry; also intensely passionate
sentence: The column marched through torrid desert air for six hours without shade.

meaning: going far beyond ordinary limits; surpassing everything of its kind
sentence: Her transcendent skill on the rifle range put her in a class of her own.

meaning: a person who journeys from place to place
sentence: A tired traveller asked for directions to the nearest rest house.

meaning: a store of valuable things; also to value something very greatly
sentence: He will treasure that letter from his commanding officer for the rest of his life.

meaning: to shake slightly and uncontrollably, from cold, fear or weakness
sentence: His hands began to tremble as he waited outside the interview room.

meaning: the use of deception to cheat or mislead
sentence: He won the argument by plain trickery rather than by evidence.

meaning: ready to place confidence in others without suspicion
sentence: A trustful child will hand over his savings to anyone who asks kindly.

meaning: that which is in accordance with fact or reality
sentence: The inquiry finally established the truth about the missing stores.

meaning: cruel and oppressive rule by somebody holding absolute power
sentence: The revolt began as a protest against the tyranny of the local governor.

meaning: not confident enough to state one's views or press one's claims
sentence: He is too unassertive to remind his seniors that the credit was his.

meaning: unkind or harsh in judging others
sentence: It was uncharitable of him to call the new recruit lazy after one bad morning.

meaning: not conforming to accepted rules, customs or ways of doing things
sentence: His unconventional method of teaching mathematics puzzled the inspectors but worked.

meaning: not given a clear meaning, limit or shape
sentence: His duties in the new post remained undefined for the first month.

meaning: lacking dignity; appearing foolish or unseemly
sentence: There was an undignified scramble for seats when the bus finally arrived.

meaning: always right; never making a mistake
sentence: She has an unerring eye for a weak argument.

meaning: not in good health, or not good for the health
sentence: Long hours in a damp basement left him pale and unhealthy.

meaning: unvarying and the same throughout; also the official dress of a service or school
sentence: The bricks were baked to a uniform size so that the wall would sit true.

meaning: not easily seen or observed
sentence: The repair was so neat as to be almost unnoticeable.

meaning: causing discomfort or displeasure
sentence: An unpleasant smell rose from the drain behind the kitchen.

meaning: not able to be foreseen; changing without warning
sentence: The weather in the hills is unpredictable, so carry a raincoat.

meaning: lacking the learning or rigour expected of a scholar
sentence: The essay was lively but unscholarly, quoting no source at all.

meaning: having no special training, or needing none
sentence: Most of the work at the site was unskilled and paid by the day.

meaning: the state of not being right or fitting for a purpose
sentence: The unsuitability of the ground for landing was clear from the air.

meaning: showing no pity or understanding for another's trouble
sentence: The clerk was unsympathetic and told him to come back with the form.

meaning: to remove a covering from something; also to make something known for the first time
sentence: The Chief of Staff arrived to unveil the memorial to the fallen.

meaning: reluctance to do something
sentence: His unwillingness to answer plainly made everyone suspicious.

meaning: showing poor judgement; foolish
sentence: It would be unwise to attempt the pass after dark.

meaning: relating to a town or city
sentence: Urban traffic has doubled in the ten years since the bypass was built.

meaning: able to be put to good use; serving a purpose
sentence: A length of rope is the most useful thing in any kit bag.

meaning: thoroughly defeated in battle or contest
sentence: The vanquished army withdrew across the river before dawn.

meaning: the showing of strong and forceful feeling
sentence: He denied the charge with a vehemence that surprised the whole room.

meaning: the use of far more words than are needed
sentence: The verboseness of the report buried its one useful recommendation.

meaning: able to be seen
sentence: The signal light was visible from three kilometres out at sea.

meaning: a person who moves about without a fixed destination or home
sentence: He lived as a wanderer for a year, staying nowhere longer than a week.

meaning: a statement or sign alerting somebody to a danger or a fault
sentence: The board carried a warning about loose rocks on the upper slope.

meaning: to hesitate between choices; also to move unsteadily to and fro
sentence: He did not waver once the order had been given.

meaning: lack of strength or firmness; also a liking one cannot resist
sentence: His one weakness is a plate of hot jalebis after the evening run.

meaning: readily and of one's own accord
sentence: Half the platoon willingly gave up their Sunday to clear the flooded road.

meaning: like a wolf; fiercely greedy or predatory in look or manner
sentence: He eyed the last plate of food with a wolfish grin.

meaning: to become worse, or to make something worse
sentence: Delaying the operation will only worsen the injury.

meaning: to take something away forcibly, after a struggle
sentence: It took two men to wrest the burning canister from his hands.

meaning: a person who writes books, articles or other texts
sentence: The writer of the letter had signed only his initials.

meaning: to give way under pressure or to authority; also to produce or bring forth
sentence: The old gate would not yield until three of us pushed together.
